jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join our R&D team. You'll lead initiatives in machine learning, NLP, and model deployment for customer-facing products.
responsibilities: Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML models
Work with NLP technologies to enhance customer support tools
Collaborate with product and design teams to deliver AI-powered features
requirements: 5+ years in machine learning or AI

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description: As a Customer Success Manager, you’ll ensure our clients succeed with our AI-driven support tools. Help customers onboard, train, and optimize their service experience.
responsibilities: Serve as a primary point of contact
Identify upsell opportunities and improve retention
requirements: 3+ years in a customer-facing SaaS role
Strong communication and project management skills
Experience in AI or tech support is a plus

jobs.title: Content Marketing Specialist
jobs.description: Join our marketing team to create engaging blog posts, whitepapers, and social content about AI and customer support innovation.
responsibilities: Write and edit blog posts, newsletters, and web copy
Collaborate with designers and product marketers
Use SEO tools to optimize content
requirements: 2+ years in content marketing or journalism
Understanding of B2B SaaS and/or AI is preferred
